summary: Created AppraisalAuditLog Pydantic models in back/app/llm/appraisal_audit_log.py, wired audit entry collection into simulate_day_bridged for T1/T2/T4 router calls, introduced backward-compatible SimulateDayBridgedResult that allows 2-element tuple unpacking for existing callers while exposing the audit log at index [2], and wrote 18 tests covering all required test scenarios.
diff_summary: tick_bridge.py: added SimulateDayBridgedResult class (backward-compatible 3-element container), _build_audit_entry() helper, AppraisalAuditLog construction at end of simulate_day_bridged, audit entry collection after T1/T2/T4 router calls, updated return type annotation and return statement. appraisal_audit_log.py: new file with AppraisalAuditEntry and AppraisalAuditLog Pydantic models. test_p31_t4_appraisal_audit_log.py: 18 tests covering 3-element result, backward-compat unpacking, 2-entry and 3-entry scenarios, T4-skip, LLM success, connection failure, parse failure, STRUCTURAL_FAIL, severe deviation, timestamp_iso UTC validity, module import side-effect check.
unresolved_issues: raw_llm_response in audit entries is always None when populated through tick_bridge — RouterResult does not carry ShadowRunResult.raw_response, and appraisal_router.py is in the forbidden files list. The field exists on AppraisalAuditEntry for future use or for callers that populate it directly.
